description: Fetch one escrow by its base-58 PDA address, including its state as mirrored by the Escro API (it can briefly lag the chain; the program is authoritative). Amounts are in micro-USDC (6 decimals). Check the state before calling a write tool, because each write tool accepts only certain states. Read-only; needs no wallet.
name: get_escrow
title: Get escrow
